intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Jay sets a tablet down, opens a file, and frowns at it.

teach0.speaker: javascript
teach0.text: Comments. Short lesson. Comments are text the compiler ignores. They exist for the next person who reads the code.

teach1.speaker: javascript
teach1.text: Two kinds. // comments out the rest of a line. /* and */ wrap a block, as many lines as you need.

teach2.speaker: javascript
teach2.text: Also, there is a line in this file I did not write. Three exclamation points. That is not my style. Comment it out. I want a record of it.

passed.speaker: javascript
passed.text: Correct. The policy is documented, and the unauthorized line is out of service. Good work, {player}.

failed.speaker: javascript
failed.text: That does not compile yet. Read the error message. Then try again.

bye.speaker: javascript
bye.text: Understood. Office hours are every weekday. Bring the error message.
